_comment: Starting loadout roll (LoadoutConfig in core/include/rm/content.h). Each run starts with budget points: one weapon from the skin or character starting_weapons list (cost by weapon category), then random equipment until the points run out; unspent points become starting supplies. The RE5 adapter applies only the weapon (as the sidearm damage class); equipment is tracked by the run until an inventory write is verified. game_item is the RE5 inventory id ((category << 8) | index; category 1 = weapons and grenades, 3 = recovery items), applied at match start when known.
